messages.author: c89471eda5dca12c
messages.subject: high dimension
parts:
Hello Guys

I have a data set with 500 variables and need to do a path analysis using lavaan.

Is there a limit of variables to do it ?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: high dimension
parts: Is there a limit of variables to do it ?

No theoretical "limit", but in practice, optimization will get slower the more parameters you have.  And the number of parameters certainly should never approach your sample size.  By "path analysis" I assume you are not reducing the 500 variables to fewer dimensions via a CFA/measurement model -- I don't know why you would need to keep track of the inter-relations among 500 different moving parts at once, but I would advise you start small and build up.  That way you will start to notice when the optimization takes a long time to converge on a solution. 

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
UvA web page: http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: high dimension
parts:
Some other practical issues when using a large number of variables:

- use NACOV = FALSE (unless you need robust SE, or a scaled test statistic)
- start with se="none", and test="standard"

Yves.
